# Create the accessions data list:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

all_gtdb_raw <- read.table("/Users/ptran5/Downloads/genomes-greA/all_gtdb_tables/all_clean_accessions.txt", sep="\t",comment = "", header=TRUE)

all_gtdb_raw_unique <- all_gtdb_raw %>% distinct()

old_accessions <- read.table("/Users/ptran5/Downloads/genomes-greA/all_gtdb_tables/unique_to_old_accessions.txt")

new_accessions <- read.table("/Users/ptran5/Downloads/genomes-greA/all_gtdb_tables/unique_to_new_accessions.txt")

#view(all_gtdb_raw_unique %>% filter(accession %in% old_accessions$V1))
#view(all_gtdb_raw_unique %>% filter(accession %in% new_accessions$V1))

# Count how many have failed quality check:

all_gtdb_raw_unique %>% filter(grepl("Failed Quality Check", gtdb_taxonomy)) %>% nrow()
#14,338
view(all_gtdb_raw_unique%>% filter(grepl("Failed Quality Check", gtdb_taxonomy)))

# Keep only good quality check:
#View(all_gtdb_raw_unique%>% filter(!grepl("Failed Quality Check", gtdb_taxonomy)))
all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual <- all_gtdb_raw_unique %>% filter(!grepl("Failed Quality Check", gtdb_taxonomy))
#123,329

all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual %>% group_by(gtdb_species_representative, ncbi_type_material) %>% tally()
# Okay so some are upper case and lower case but we really need to put everything in upper case AND convert to a factor so it's properly managed with the filter.

all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual$gtdb_species_representative <- toupper(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual$gtdb_species_representative)

all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual$ncbi_type_material <- toupper(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual$ncbi_type_material)

# Reassess the tally:
all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual %>% group_by(gtdb_species_representative, ncbi_type_material) %>% tally()

# The expected number of rows after filtering.
558+14556+1277

# The majority of these (106338) are neither gtdb or ncbi type material so we will not analyse them.
# But it might be good to analyse the ncbi type material even if they are not GTDB species representative.

# For the HTCondor list, I'll use:
# Not the parenthesis:
all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered <- all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual %>%
  filter(!(gtdb_species_representative == FALSE & ncbi_type_material == FALSE))

all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered  %>% group_by(gtdb_species_representative, ncbi_type_material) %>% 
  tally()

# The first column of that table is what I want to use for the HTCondor code.
write.table(x= all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered %>% distinct(), file="Output/all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)

# Use the first column as the "accessions.txt" file for HTCondor:
write.table(x=unique(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered$accession), file="Output/accessions.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

length(unique(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered$accession))
```

There are 16 308 genomes to be accessed.


# See the file Methods.md for how to use accessions.txt to download from ncbi + run cctyper.

In summary:

```
# Transfer files from laptop to chtc
scp accessions.txt ptran5@ap2002.chtc.wisc.edu:~/all/researchers/angel/.

# log into chtc and cd into wd
cd ~/all/researchers/angel/.
# split the accessions.txt id
split -l 1000 accessions.txt
ls x* > accessions_list.txt

# Make the output directory in my staging folder
mkdir -p /staging/p/ptran5/data/ncbi_dataset/data

# submit datasets.sub script
condor_submit datasets.sub

# Watch job until it finishes...

# Once it's done, summarize the downloaded accessions
ls /staging/p/ptran5/data/ncbi_dataset/data/G* > ~/all/researchers/angel/accessions1.txt
cd ~/all/researchers/angel/

# Clean up the names
grep '/staging/p/ptran5/data/ncbi_dataset/data/' accessions1.txt | wc -l

grep '/staging/p/ptran5/data/ncbi_dataset/data/' accessions1.txt > accessions2.txt

# Remove full path
sed -i 's|/staging/p/ptran5/data/ncbi_dataset/data/||g' accessions2.txt 

sed -i 's|:||g' accessions2.txt

head -n 3 accessions2.txt > accessions2_test.txt

# accessions2_test.txt can be used for the queue statement of cctyper.sub 

# submit the cctyper job 
condor_submit cctyper.sub

# Watch until it finishes
cd /staging/p/ptran5/cctyper_out

# Go to staging and unzip results:
count=1
for file in *tar.gz; do 
  tar xf $file
  echo "Count is: $count"
  ((count++))
done

# Summarize the results:
ls **/cas_operons.tab | wc -l
```


# Load the cctyper output data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

results <- read_tsv("Data/all_cas_operons.tab") %>% filter(Contig != "Contig")

dim(results)

#write(results$Contig, "Data/contigs_with_crispr.txt")
# Send that to chtc, and make the output file.

results %>% group_by(Prediction) %>% tally() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=n, x=Prediction)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))

taxonomy <- all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered %>% distinct()

#used_in_htcondor <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE)
#nrow(used_in_htcondor)

#write.table(x= used_in_htcondor, file="Output/accessions_used_for_cctyper.txt", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)

# From the results file, create a file named `contigs_with_crispr.txt` that is made up of all the Contig ID :

write(x=unique(results$Contig), file="Data/contigs_with_crispr.txt")

#nrow(used_in_htcondor)

contigs_with_crispr <- read.table("Data/contigs_with_crispr_clean.txt", sep="\t", header=FALSE)
nrow(contigs_with_crispr)

colnames(results)

colnames(contigs_with_crispr) <- colnames(results)

contigs_with_crispr <- contigs_with_crispr %>% separate(Contig, into = c("Folder","Contig"), sep="/")

contigs_with_crispr$Contig <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$Contig, "cas_operons.tab:","")

contigs_with_crispr$Folder <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$Folder, "my_output_","")

contigs_with_crispr$accession <- contigs_with_crispr$Folder

# Remove everything after the 2nd underscore, including it
contigs_with_crispr$accession  <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$accession, "^([^_]+_[^_]+)_.*","\\1")

contigs_with_crispr <- left_join(contigs_with_crispr, taxonomy)

nrow(contigs_with_crispr)

contigs_with_crispr <- contigs_with_crispr %>% separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
    separate(ncbi_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain_ncbi","Phylum_ncbi","Class_ncbi","Order_ncbi","Family_ncbi","Genus_ncbi","Species_ncbi")) 


contigs_with_crispr %>% distinct() %>% nrow()

unique(contigs_with_crispr$accession) %>% length()

# Taxonomic distribution of the MAGs:

write.table(x= contigs_with_crispr, file="Output/contigs_with_crispr.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)

# Comparison of how many genomes were queried vs. how many had positive results.

# How many accessesions searched:
length(unique(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered$accession))
# 16308

# wc -l accessions2.txt
#16294 accessions2.txt
accessions_actually_downloaded <- read_table("Data/accessions2.txt", col_names = FALSE)
nrow(accessions_actually_downloaded)

#Difference:
length(unique(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered$accession))-nrow(accessions_actually_downloaded)

list1 <- unique(all_gtdb_raw_unique_good_qual_filtered$accession)
list2 <- accessions_actually_downloaded$X1


setdiff(list1,list2)

#There are 14 genomes we don't have data for...
# Search those in the raw GTDB data

all_gtdb_raw %>% filter(accession %in% setdiff(list1,list2))

# How many files we have data for (ncbi_datasets/data)
nrow(contigs_with_crispr)
```


# Summarize family level all the data.
```{R, eval=FALSE}

genomes_with_crispr_count <- contigs_with_crispr %>% mutate(PCOF= paste(Phylum, Class, Order, Family)) %>% select(accession, Prediction, PCOF) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(Prediction, PCOF) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_with_crispr_count)[3] <- "genomes_with_crispr"



genomes_all_count <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE) %>%
  separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
  separate(ncbi_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain_ncbi","Phylum_ncbi","Class_ncbi","Order_ncbi","Family_ncbi","Genus_ncbi","Species_ncbi")) %>%
 mutate(PCOF= paste(Phylum, Class, Order, Family)) %>% 
  select(accession,PCOF) %>%
  group_by(PCOF) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_all_count)[2] <- "total_genomes"


genomes_count <- full_join(genomes_all_count, genomes_with_crispr_count)

genomes_count <- genomes_count %>% mutate(percentage = genomes_with_crispr/total_genomes)

ggplot(genomes_count %>% filter(Prediction != "NA"), aes(x=Prediction, y=PCOF, col = percentage, fill=percentage))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral")+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F2F2", color = "black")
  )


#ggsave("figures/greA/family_level_summary.pdf", width = 11, height = 8)
```

# Genus only plot
```{r}

genus_only <- c("g__Ketogulonicigenium",
                "g__Paenibacillus",
                "g__GPS1B09",
                "g__Anaerovibrio",
                "g__Faecalibacterium",
                "g__Agathobacter", # g__Roseburia or
                "g__Methylomonas",
                "g__Methylobacterium",
                "g__Muiribacterium", #--> not there
                "g__Muriicola", #--> none in results
                "g__Defluviilinea", #--> none in results
                "g__Flavonifractor",
                "g__Herbinix",
                "g__Pseudomonas")

contigs_with_crispr_genus_gtdb <- contigs_with_crispr %>% filter(Genus %in% genus_only)
contigs_with_crispr_genus_ncbi <- contigs_with_crispr %>% filter(Genus_ncbi %in% genus_only)
contigs_with_crispr_genus <- rbind(contigs_with_crispr_genus_ncbi, contigs_with_crispr_genus_gtdb)

length(unique(contigs_with_crispr_genus$accession))

# there are 168 genomes belonging to these groups.

# Summarize the data at the genus level.
genomes_with_crispr_count_genus <- contigs_with_crispr %>% mutate(PG = paste(Phylum, "(GTDB:", Genus, "; NCBI:", Genus_ncbi,")")) %>% filter(Genus %in% genus_only) %>%
  select(accession, Prediction, PG) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(Prediction, PG) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_with_crispr_count_genus)[3] <- "genomes_with_crispr"


genomes_all_count_genus <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE) %>%
  separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
  separate(ncbi_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain_ncbi","Phylum_ncbi","Class_ncbi","Order_ncbi","Family_ncbi","Genus_ncbi","Species_ncbi")) %>%
  mutate(PG = paste(Phylum, "(GTDB:", Genus, "; NCBI:", Genus_ncbi,")")) %>% 
  filter(Genus %in% genus_only | Genus_ncbi %in% genus_only) %>%
  select(accession,PG) %>%
  group_by(PG) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_all_count_genus)[2] <- "total_genomes"


genomes_count_genus <- full_join(genomes_all_count_genus, genomes_with_crispr_count_genus)

genomes_count_genus <- genomes_count_genus %>% mutate(percentage = genomes_with_crispr/total_genomes)

write.table(genomes_count_genus, file = "Output/genus_count_table.tsv",sep="\t", row.names = FALSE)

heatmap_genus <- ggplot(genomes_count_genus %>% filter(Prediction != "NA"), aes(x=Prediction, y=PG, col = percentage, fill=percentage))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_color_distiller(name = "Fraction", palette = "Spectral")+
  scale_fill_distiller(name = "Fraction", palette = "Spectral")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1),
    text = element_text(color="black", size=9),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F2F2", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

heatmap_genus

library(forcats)

bar_genus <- ggplot(
  genomes_count_genus %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Prediction)) %>% 
    select(PG, genomes_with_crispr, total_genomes) %>% 
    gather("type", "count", genomes_with_crispr, total_genomes) %>% 
    group_by(PG, type) %>%
    summarize(sum_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop"),
  
  aes(x = sum_count, y = PG, fill = fct_rev(type))) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sum_count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("genomes_with_crispr"="#93193a",
                              "total_genomes"="#2f3794")) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color="black", size=9),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    #legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlab("Genome count")

bar_genus

library(ggpubr)

ggarrange(heatmap_genus, bar_genus, align = "h")
bar_genus_minimal <- bar_genus + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position="none")

ggarrange(heatmap_genus, bar_genus_minimal, align = "h", widths = c(1,0.5))

ggsave(filename = "Output/heatmap_barplot_genus_level_summary.pdf", 
       width = 8.5, 
       height = 4)

```
